lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: Update season is here. Today there are lots of slow laptops and misbehaving apps.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: The System Care chapter is open: full disks, delayed updates, and fussy drivers.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: If a problem shows up right after something changed, suspect that change first.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: The office laptops are fresh again. Tomorrow is your last day as the new technician. Get ready.

lines.speaker: kelabu
lines.text: The IT Workshop, huh? A nice place to leave something behind...
